why: Begin the required accessory range with a source-bound, visually checked straw-hat prototype before expanding poses or accepting playable recipes.
scope: Base standing pose 8 only; two current hairstyles, both facings, day/night and two scales. Not available in player custom looks.
tool: Built-in imagegen, true alpha, three non-destructive candidates; exact prompts/reference roles in generation.json.

visualFindings.v1: Rejected: size/placement wrong and disconnected paint fragment.
visualFindings.v2: Rejected after game renderer capture: oversized brim obscures eyes.
visualFindings.v3: Accepted for single-pose development: eyes visible, natural forehead/ear contact and modest brim, painted straw/brown band consistent beside Iara and original world artwork.

remaining: 47 other poses, hand/tool occlusion, transitions, all material/colour combinations, portrait crop and native recipe/save/player-control integration. Other body/face/clothing/facial-hair/accessory and release requirements remain open.
